info.title: OrbitBoyzz / Orbit Websites API
info.summary: Public read-only API for the OrbitBoyzz (Orbit Websites) marketing site.
info.description: Endpoints for programmatically requesting a project price range and checking service health. No authentication is required. Human-readable docs live at https://orbitboyzz.com/developers.

post.summary: Estimate a website project price range
post.description: Returns a rough upfront build figure (not a quote), an optional monthly care plan or AI retainer range, and (when relevant) an AI employee monthly cost range, based on the same logic used by the /quote page's project range estimator. Pricing model: a simple (launch-level) website has no published price and is quoted on a free call (upfront = "Quoted on a free call", upfrontLow/upfrontHigh = null; 7-day sprint, 50% to start and 50% on approval); a moderate or complex website is a premium build from $3,500 (upfrontLow = 3500, upfrontHigh = null); any AI selection (need = ai, an AI employee, or automation = true) is an AI operations build of $5,000–$15,000+ with an optional $750–$2,500/mo retainer; website care plans are optional at $300–$700/mo.

launchSite.summary: Simple launch website (quoted on a free call)

400.description: One or more fields were missing or invalid.

405.description: Method other than POST was used.

get.description: Lightweight liveness check for the site's API. Returns status and server time.

employee.description: Which AI employee/workflow (if any) to include.

automation.description: Whether to add an automation layer (follow-up, routing, booking logic, or an AI workflow) on top of a non-AI build. Priced as an AI operations build.

upfront.description: Formatted upfront build figure: "Quoted on a free call" (launch build), "From $3,500" (premium build) or "$5,000–$15,000+" (AI operations build).

upfrontLow.description: Lowest published upfront figure in USD, or null when the build is quoted on a free call.

upfrontHigh.description: Typical upper upfront figure in USD (15000 for AI builds, which can run higher), or null when there is no published upper figure.

monthly.description: Formatted optional monthly range: "$300–$700/mo" (website care plans) or "$750–$2,500/mo" (AI operations retainer).

employeeCost.description: Formatted AI employee monthly cost range, or "N/A".

savings.description: Human-readable comparison to hiring an employee.

hint.description: Suggested next step for resolving the error.
